project_name.justification: Signal Gold Inc. ("Signal Gold" or the "Company") (TSX:SGNL) (OTCQX:SGNLF) is pleased to announce it has acquired a 100% interest in six (6) exploration licenses adjacent to the Goldboro Mineral Resource at its Goldboro Gold Project in Nova Scotia, Canada ("Goldboro", or the "Project").

company_name.justification: The article identifies the acquiring company as: "Signal Gold Inc. ("Signal Gold" or the "Company") (TSX:SGNL) (OTCQX:SGNLF) is pleased to announce it has acquired a 100% interest in six (6) exploration licenses..."

ceo_buyer.justification: A quote in the article is attributed to: "~Kevin Bullock, President and CEO, Signal Gold Inc."

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The text states that the company "...acquired a 100% interest in six (6) exploration licenses adjacent to the Goldboro Mineral Resource..."

primary_commodity.justification: The project is consistently referred to as the "Goldboro Gold Project".

verified_article_link.justification: The article is titled "Signal Gold Significantly Expands Its Exploration License Area Adjacent To The Goldboro Gold Project" and discusses the acquisition of licenses for this project.

currency.justification: The text mentions payments in '$'. As the acquiring company, Signal Gold Inc., is listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX), the currency is inferred to be Canadian Dollars (CAD). The payment is described as: "total purchase price of $700,000".

cash_payments_raw.justification: The total purchase price is described as being "...comprised of $400,000 in cash and $300,000 in common shares of Signal Gold..."

share_payments_raw.justification: The total purchase price is described as being "...comprised of $400,000 in cash and $300,000 in common shares of Signal Gold..."

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The individual cash and share payment components were explicitly provided, so this combined field is not applicable.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The transaction resulted in "...the issuance of 900,901 common shares of the Company."

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: The press release does not mention any share warrant payments as part of the transaction.

option_payments_raw.justification: The press release does not mention any option payments as part of the transaction.

issued_share_price.justification: The shares were issued "...at a deemed value of $0.333 per common share, based on the 20-day volume weighted average price as of November 16, 2022..."

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: The press release does not mention a specific exploration commitment in meters.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: The press release does not mention a specific exploration commitment value as part of the acquisition terms.

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: As part of the transaction terms, "The Company also granted to Meguma Gold Inc. a 1.0% royalty over the licenses acquired..." This represents a royalty retained by the seller.

coverage_area_raw.justification: The area acquired is calculated from the total increase in land holdings resulting from the transaction. The text states: "As a result, Signal Gold has increased its exploration license area from 599 hectares to 3,756 hectares." The acquired area is the difference (3756 - 599 = 3157).

coverage_area_unit.justification: The unit is specified in the text: "As a result, Signal Gold has increased its exploration license area from 599 hectares to 3,756 hectares."

resource_size.value: Probable Mineral Reserves of 1.15 million ounces of gold (15.80 million tonnes at 2.26 g/t gold), Measured and Indicated Mineral Resources inclusive of Mineral Reserves of 2.58 million ounces (21.6 million tonnes at 3.72 g/t gold) and additional Inferred Mineral Resources of 0.48 million ounces (3.18 million tonnes at 4.73 g/t gold)
resource_size.justification: The 'ABOUT SIGNAL GOLD' section provides a resource estimate for the Goldboro project: "Probable Mineral Reserves of 1.15 million ounces of gold (15.80 million tonnes at 2.26 g/t gold), Measured and Indicated Mineral Resources inclusive of Mineral Reserves of 2.58 million ounces (21.6 million tonnes at 3.72 g/t gold) and additional Inferred Mineral Resources of 0.48 million ounces (3.18 million tonnes at 4.73 g/t gold)".
